text: {"lessons":["My account rose 7.0% and then fell 0.8%, so a short-term gain or loss is not a reliable reason by itself to trade.","I bought all five stocks after both a down period and an up period; I should use a consistent plan rather than react to recent account performance.","With my apartment goal less than ten years away, I should track risk and progress toward that goal, not just account value month to month."]}
